text:
incbot: INCIDENT: metering-pipeline delay detected — token emit lag > 30m for multiple shards. Some customers flagged for overages. Pager sent to @oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-delay :rotating_light:

jordan: I'm oncall — looking. Seeing Kafka consumer lag climb on consumer-group=metering-ingest-consumers. Starting live triage.

maria: billing-ops joining — we're getting CS tickets about sudden overage emails. Can we suppress notifications while we sort counts?

alex: quick update: ingest-worker-3 restarted automatically at 22:27 UTC, OOMKilled. Pod kept restarting and fell behind. Restarted manually and scaled replicas from 3 -> 5 to drain backlog.

jordan: running quick checks:
```
kubectl -n metering get pods -o wide
kubectl -n metering logs ingest-worker-3 --since=20m
```

maria: thanks. I'll pause alerting to customers for affected orgs (org ids: org_11, org_42) and send CS template. Pausing: `billing-notify --pause --org org_11,org_42`

alex: starting backfill job to reprocess the missing windowed counts. Kickoff command: `./tools/replay_usage --start 2026-03-16T22:00Z --end 2026-03-16T22:30Z --shards 8`

jordan: monitoring metrics: emit_lag (kafka) trending down after scale, tokens_processed per min climbing back to normal. ETA for backlog drain ~12m.

slo-bot: SLO ALERT: metering.emit_latency at 99p breached 30m (15% increased latency).

maria: rolling out suppression for customer-facing overage emails now. Notifying CS (cc @cs) with mitigations & ETA.

alex: note: root cause looks like a memory leak in shard deserializer introduced in deploy 2026-03-16T21:45Z. Reverting that commit in canary and scheduling rollback to prod after stabilizing replicas.

jordan: mitigation checklist: 1) pause notifications (done) 2) scale replicas (done) 3) run backfill (in progress) 4) monitor and rollback patch if confirmed.

maria: CS message posted: "We're aware of inflated overage emails for a subset of customers due to a metering backlog. We've paused notifications and are reconciling counts; you will not be billed for duplicate flags. ETA 30-60m."

alex: backfill job status: 30% complete, reprocessing ~120k messages/min. No duplicates expected because replay uses idempotent keys.

jordan: after backfill completes we'll run a reconciliation script and mark affected invoices as reconciled if necessary. Will attach reconciliation runbook here.

incbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: backlog decreasing, notifications paused, rollback planned. Impact: transient overage flags only — billing amounts likely unaffected post-recon.

maria: final ask for now: SRE please keep ingest lag <5k and confirm stable for 15m before unpausing notifications.

alex: ack. will post when stable.

jordan: switching to handoff mode in 20m. Leaving notes in the incident doc. If anyone sees new alerts ping. :thumbsup:

slo-bot: AUTOLOG: incident_id=INC-2026-0456 severity=medium scope=metering duration_est=45m

maria: thanks all — CS will follow up with affected customers once reconciliation completes.

jordan: last check: emit_lag 2.1k, tokens_processed back to baseline, backfill 100% complete, reconciliation run queued. Closing active pager; handoff to ops for post-incident follow-up.

incbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: root cause identified (deserializer mem leak), rollback scheduled, no charge anomalies expected after reconciliation.
